Zar. 11ᵇ סך קירי פלסטר (Ms. M. בר), an alleged proclamation, made in Rome on the occasion of a sort of secular game, and intended as a satire of Esau (Rome) on his brother Jacob (Judaism). The interpretations of commentaries (סך number of years predicted for the coming of the Messiah, or סך brother) are unsatisfactory.
